body:
## Pull request overview This PR reduces shipped bundle size across the Field/Form/Fieldset family by removing redundant internal code paths and simplifying registration/validation logic while aiming to keep behavior unchanged (and adding regression tests for key flows). **Changes:** - Simplifies internal registration/ID plumbing (moving to `useRefWithInit`, ref-based field ID tracking, and trimming `FieldRootContext` surface area). - Refactors `
` submission/focus behavior to focus the first invalid control consistently and streamlines error clearing / form value collection. - Adjusts field validation logic around native validity revalidation and adds tests to cover the updated behavior. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/react/src/internals/labelable-provider/useLabelableId.ts | Removes the Symbol description string to reduce bytes. | | packages/react/src/internals/field-root-context/FieldRootContext.ts | Trims unused context fields/defaults to reduce dead exports and surface area. | | packages/react/src/internals/field-register-control/useRegisterFieldControl.ts | Uses `useRefWithInit` for stable per-control symbols and simplifies guards/deps. | | packages/react/src/internals/field-register-control/useFieldControlRegistration.ts | Removes fallback refs and switches registered field ID tracking to a ref. | | packages/react/src/form/Form.tsx | Refactors submit/focus flow and error handling; uses `Object.hasOwn` for own-property checks. | | packages/react/src/form/Form.test.tsx | Adds coverage for focusing first invalid field, external error replacement, and Strict Mode registration targeting. | | packages/react/src/fieldset/root/FieldsetRootContext.ts | Tightens context typing for `disabled` to always be boolean. | | packages/react/src/fieldset/legend/FieldsetLegend.tsx | Aligns legend state with new non-optional `disabled` context value. | | packages/react/src/field/validity/FieldValidity.tsx | Documents memoization rationale for the render-prop state object identity. | | packages/react/src/field/validity/FieldValidity.test.tsx | Adds coverage for deferring stale custom errors across validation boundaries. |
